categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Qingyi Photomask Limited primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of photomasks used in electronic component manufacturing. Its main product lines include quartz and soda-lime photomasks applied in flat panel displays, semiconductor chips, touch panels, and circuit boards. The company operates through subsidiaries focusing on photomask production and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on advanced photolithography technologies including laser direct writing and electron beam writing for photomask production. It has developed proprietary core process technologies such as high-precision CD measurement, HTM (half-tone mask), PSM (phase shift mask), and OPC (optical proximity correction) techniques. It also invests in equipment R&D, including laser repair machines and precision measurement devices, and employs intelligent manufacturing and quality control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading flat panel display manufacturers like BOE, Visionox, HKC, Tianma, CSOT, and semiconductor companies including Chiplet manufacturers, IC foundries, and advanced packaging firms such as SMIC, BYD Semiconductor, Sanan Optoelectronics, and Changjiang Electronics. The company serves industries including flat panel displays, semiconductors, touch panels, and flexible circuit boards, with products used in smartphones, laptops, automotive displays, and micro-LED applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Hefei, and Foshan, and a commercial presence in Hong Kong. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets extensively and also include exports to regions such as Taiwan and Singapore. The company is positioned to serve global markets through its Chinese manufacturing hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Qingyi Photomask Limited operates upstream in the semiconductor and flat panel display supply chain as a photomask manufacturer. It supplies critical photolithography masks to downstream electronic component manufacturers and fabs, acting as a key enabler in the production of semiconductors, displays, and touch panels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with a focus on developing high-precision photomasks for AMOLED, LTPS, LTPO, and advanced semiconductor nodes down to 28nm. It invests in R&D for new mask types like HTM and PSM to accelerate domestic substitution of imported high-end photomasks. Expansion of production capacity, intelligent manufacturing, and enhancement of product quality and precision are strategic priorities. The company also focuses on talent acquisition and collaborative innovation to sustain growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized photomask products to industrial clients. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, fulfilling contracts with flat panel display manufacturers, semiconductor fabs, and other electronics producers. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales and related technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks as the largest domestic photomask manufacturer in China and is among the top five globally in flat panel display photomask sales. Major international competitors include companies like Photronics (USA), Toppan, SKE, HOYA (Japan), and LG-IT (South Korea). Qingyi holds a leading position in China with growing market share, especially in mid-to-high-end photomasks, but faces strong competition from established global players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 20.35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 172 million, up 28.49%. Total assets grew by 32.07% to RMB 2.74 billion. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by capacity expansion and product mix optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingyi Photomask emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product precision, and comprehensive product portfolio covering various photomask types for flat panel displays and semiconductors. Its domestic manufacturing bases provide proximity advantages for timely delivery and localized service. The company’s focus on innovation, quality control, and intelligent manufacturing enables it to break import dependence in China’s photomask market and meet the evolving needs of high-end display and semiconductor customers.
